title: Enrich on-call diagnostics with automated runbook suggestions and triage helpers
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: On-call teams often waste critical minutes assembling the same diagnostic surface (pod logs, recent deploys, graph snapshots, SLO deltas) before they can follow runbooks. This PR adds an automated diagnostics gatherer plus a lightweight runbook-suggestion engine to incident-bot so on-call responders get an actionable triage checklist and templated next steps in Slack/PagerDuty threads. Motivation: reduce mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) and mean time to resolution (MTTR) by surfacing high-value signals automatically and recommending runbook steps tailored to the observed signals. Summary of changes: 1) diagnostics worker: new background worker that gathers a bounded set of artifacts (pod logs tails, pod event summaries, recent deploy metadata, SLO deltas from slo-toolkit, topology hints) with configurable TTL and size limits; 2) suggestion engine: rule-based scorer + template library that maps diagnostic signatures to ranked runbook suggestions and immediate mitigation commands; 3) on-call commands: /incident-diagnose which triggers a diagnostics snapshot and posts a suggested runbook checklist back into Slack; 4) triage UI: compact summary card and links to full artifacts (pre-signed URLs) plus confidence score; 5) observability and audit: metrics for diagnoses-per-hour, avg suggestion confidence, and feature flags to enable/disable production use. Compatibility: integrates with existing Slack and PagerDuty hooks, and fetches SLOs using the slo-toolkit API. Security: diagnostics snapshots include redaction hooks and respect KMS-backed secrets; we add an opt-out setting per team. Rollout: feature-gated behind the config flag incident_bot.autorunbook.enabled (default off). Rollout plan includes staged enablement for internal SRE team, canary on a small Slack workspace, and full rollout after 2 weeks of monitoring. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for scorer heuristics - [x] Integration tests against a local slo-toolkit stub - [x] e2e test that posts to a test Slack workspace - [x] Docs + runbook templates added - [x] Feature flag covered and telemetry emitted Testing notes: use the provided test harness under test/harness/diagnostics to simulate cluster events and SLO regressions. See linear ENG-942 for acceptance criteria and the linked design doc (internal link) for decision rationale. Backwards compatibility: when the feature flag is off, no runtime change; the commands are hidden. Rollback: disable feature flag and revoke pre-signed artifact URLs if necessary.

release_notes: Add automated on-call diagnostics and runbook suggestion engine for incident-bot. Feature is behind a feature flag (incident_bot.autorunbook.enabled). Enables /incident-diagnose command to produce a ranked list of suggested runbook steps and links to collected artifacts. Default disabled; internal rollout first.
risk_assessment: Medium. New background worker will increase API calls to slo-toolkit and create temporary artifact storage; mitigations include rate limits, feature flag, and TTLs. Redaction pipeline lowers risk of secret leaks.
deploy_instructions: Apply k8s manifest deploy/k8s/diag-worker-deployment.yaml to a canary namespace first. Enable incident_bot.autorunbook.enabled for the internal SRE workspace via configs/feature_flags.yml. Monitor metrics: diag_snapshots_total, suggestion_confidence_histogram, and slack_command_error_rate. Revert by setting flag to false and removing canary manifest.
